interview.name: Mara
interview.answer: The notes do not say when or where the repair drive is being held.

reflections: Mara is proactive and willing to help with community efforts when given a clear next step.
Jules and Mara have a collaborative working relationship: Mara asks for help, and Jules responds with concrete follow-through.
The group values coordination and verification, especially checking current availability and what supplies are still needed before acting.
Mara relies on several people for coordinated repair-drive support and responds with appreciation when others take initiative.
Jules is proactive and task-oriented, offering to organize availability and next steps for the group.
Cleo and Gus are each contributing concrete resources and status updates, helping keep the repair drive supplied and moving.
Mara is coordinating the repair drive and acts as the main point of contact across the group.
Cleo, Gus, Tess, and Pia are each contributing in different ways, with Gus handling tools, Tess tracking staffing, and Pia needing specifics before committing.
The group is cooperative and responsive, and Mara is actively closing information gaps so coordination can move forward.
Mara is coordinating the repair drive and repeatedly asks for availability, tasks, and details to keep momentum.
Tess and Leo are responsive helpers who commit to follow-up updates and status checks.
Several people can participate, but they need concrete logistics before committing, especially exact tools, parts, and location.
Mara is coordinating the repair drive and acts as the main hub for updates, staffing, and supplies.
Bo prefers concise, actionable updates and is willing to handle logistics once details are shared.
Leo, Gus, and Noah are responsive helpers who each take on specific follow-through tasks when asked.

events.text: Hana: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping things off at the community center this afternoon, and they’re especially looking for tools and spare parts.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Mara: That’s good to know — I can swing by the community center this afternoon and drop off a few spare parts if they’re still collecting.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Hana: That should be perfect — just check with the center when you get there so you know they’re still taking them.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—want me to check who’s available and what still needs doing?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mara: Yes, please—could you check who’s available and what tasks still need doing? That would really help us keep the repair drive moving.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who’s free and what’s left on the list, then I’ll report back to you soon.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Cleo: I’ve still got the supplies list open, and I’ll let you know if anything’s running low for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — that’d be really helpful. I’m still planning to swing by the community center this afternoon with those spare parts.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep watching the list and let you know if we still need anything else for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a hammer and some screwdrivers you can borrow for the repair drive. Just swing by and I’ll hand them over.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll swing by this afternoon. I can drop off the spare parts at the community center and pick up the hammer and screwdrivers too.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — that works for me. I’ll have the hammer and screwdrivers ready when you stop by.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on, and it sounds like things are going well so far. I’ll let you know if I hear any changes or if they need extra hands.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — please keep me posted on who’s free and any tasks that still need doing. That’ll help us keep the repair drive moving.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along who’s free and what still needs doing. If anything changes, you’ll hear it from me right away.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Pia: Late morning still works for me, but I need the exact list of tools and replacement parts before I can commit to anything else.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Mara: That makes sense, Pia — I’ll get you the exact list of tools and replacement parts, and check who’s available too.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — send me the repair drive details and I’ll skim them quick.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll check who’s available and what still needs doing, then send you the key repair drive details.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Bo: I’ll check the exact location and get back to you. Sunday at the community center works for me.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Leo: I’ll drop off the repair drive details later today. If you need anything else for it, just let me know.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — could you also check who’s available and what tasks still need doing? That would really help keep the repair drive moving.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll check who’s free and list the remaining tasks, then I’ll send you a quick update.
events.speaker: Leo

events.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — I’ll keep the hammer and screwdrivers ready for you this afternoon.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — I’ll stop by this afternoon to pick them up and drop off the spare parts at the community center.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Noah — that helps. I’ll wait for the exact time and list, then I’ll pass it along.
events.speaker: Gus
